title: Staged Materials at a Failed Visit — Ridgeline Installation Services
content:
Materials that have long been waiting on site when a Ridgeline Installation Services visit fails carry a staged-materials share of the failed-visit trip charge, and a visit made before all the materials arrived carries a reduced one.

**Clause.** Staged-materials share of the failed-visit trip charge: the staging days are the calendar days from the date all materials were received to the failed visit; staging days of at least the staged-materials days of 14 take the staged-materials multiple of 1.15, materials received after the failed visit (negative staging days) take the unstaged-materials share of 0.8, and any other staging takes a staged-materials share of 1.

The failed-visit trip charge is multiplied by the staged-materials share; neither the share nor any amount formed on the way to the failed-visit trip charge is rounded, the failed-visit trip charge being rounded to the cent only at the end.

## Terms used

- **The date all materials were received** is the materials received date on the contract record, recorded by the store.
- **The failed visit** is the most recent visit recorded on the contract at which the customer was absent or the site was not ready.

| Staging days | Staged-materials share |
|---|---|
| 14 or more | 1.15 |
| 0 to 13 | 1 |
| negative (materials received after the failed visit) | 0.8 |
| no materials received date on the contract | 1 |

## Boundary dates (hypothetical failed visit on 20 September)

| Materials received | Staging days | Share |
|---|---|---|
| 6 September | 14 | 1.15 |
| 7 September | 13 | 1 |
| 20 September | 0 | 1 |
| 22 September | -2 | 0.8 |

**Hypothetical:** a trip charge of 149.00 before the share becomes 171.35 with 14 staging days, and 119.20 when the materials arrived after the visit.
